notes: Dedicated Warehouse Ledger Page. Moves the existing Stock-only Warehouse In / Out Ledger out of the Operations work-record stream and into its own page, while keeping the same Build078 calculation source. Adds a compact Warehouse In / Out Ledger entry between the Operations command buttons and search field, with live month IN/OUT badges. The ledger page includes Back to Operations, 3-inch Cut Allowance and View Work Records shortcuts. No inventory quantity, Cloud Master, Receiving, Shipping, Return, Carpet Cutting, or ledger calculation rule is changed.
